event_summary: An orange spherical object enters from the left, moves rightward across a pale tabletop, and exits at the right edge while other visible objects remain stationary.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a pale rectangular tabletop in front of a yellow sofa. A small dark object with an orange/red end lies near the rear-center of the tabletop, and a black cylindrical object is partly visible at the far left edge. After several still frames, an orange sphere appears from the left side of the tabletop, travels rightward across the table surface with visible motion blur, passes below and in front of the rear-center object without visible contact, reaches the right edge, and disappears from view. The tabletop, sofa, rear-center object, and black cylinder do not visibly change position.

reasons: The tabletop and stationary objects are visible before the orange sphere appears.
The orange sphere involved in the later motion is not yet visible in the first frame.
